capabilities: Browse the vault in folder, property, and hierarchical-tag modes in one sidebar
Create virtual folders from property values or tag prefixes
Group and collapse properties in the native Properties panel and Bases table headers
Order properties alphabetically with pins or by manual drag
Batch rename, remove, and replace properties and add or remove frontmatter tags
disambiguation: Its 'folders' are presentation-only virtual views; the plugin never creates directories, moves notes, or rewrites .base files.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README says acceptance into the community plugin directory is still pending. Interface ships in English and Simplified Chinese.
intentEvidence: Adds saved virtual subfolders generated from a property value or tag prefix, without creating folders or moving files.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only mirrors physical folders, so notes cannot be navigated by property values or tag hierarchies, and the Properties panel and Bases tables offer no way to group related fields.

relations.evidence: Property Explorer remains stronger if you only want a dedicated property browser with its own sorting options.
Compatible Foldable Frontmatter Groups settings can be reused and mirrored locally.
It intentionally omits related-note scoring; Tag Tactician remains useful for that workflow.
Existing Pinit order can be imported once when no Facet Folders pin order exists.

summary: Sidebar explorer that browses a vault by physical folders, frontmatter properties, or hierarchical tags, with virtual metadata folders and property grouping in Properties and Bases.
